title: Release evidence
description: Per-release record of the RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md gates for one tool repo, written to docs/releases/v<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.<PATCH>/release-evidence.json. This schema is for editors and reviewers only: check-release-evidence.mjs does not read it, because the validator must stay dependency-free and because most of the rules that matter are cross-file (they compare this document against the gate registry embedded in RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md) and cannot be expressed in JSON Schema at all.

schema_version.description: Shape of this document. Bumped only when the document's own structure changes.

tool.description: Tool slug. Equals the repository name, the /tools/<slug>/ landing segment and the scoop app name.

tag.description: Git tag for this release. release.yml step 0 refuses an evidence file whose tag or version is not the tag being released, so a directory copied forward from an earlier release cannot stand in for this one.

artifact_kinds.description: Which checklist tags this release claims. It MUST equal the artifact_kinds list in the repo's committed .github/release-config.yml, which is the authoritative scope; check-release-evidence.mjs reads both and reports scope-mismatch if they differ, because a scope an evidence file can narrow on release day is not a control. A gate is in scope when it is tagged [all] or when one of these tags appears on it, so a repo that runs against production directory services or access-control panels lists prod in release-config.yml alongside its artifact kind, and restates it here.

checklist_version.description: Must equal checklist_version in the RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md gate registry. A mismatch means the evidence was recorded against a different gate list and is a finding.

recorded_by.description: GitHub login of the person who recorded the result.

notes.description: Free text for anything the per-gate entries do not cover.

results.description: One entry per gate. Every gate in scope needs one; there is no 'skip' status, because an applicable gate that was not done is a failed release (the N/A rule).

id.description: Gate id from the registry, for example G15-sbom-published. Ids are stable forever; a gate is never renumbered.

status.description: pass, na or fail. na needs a reason of at least 20 characters and is refused on a gate whose registry entry sets na_allowed to false - except on a prerelease tag, where a gate carrying prerelease_na_allowed accepts na with the registry's own prerelease_na_reason_fixed wording. Which case applies is decided by this document's `tag`: a final tag is exactly vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, anything else is a prerelease.

reason.description: Why this gate is N/A, written out. Required for status na. Where the registry fixes the wording (gate 18's na_reason_fixed, or a prerelease gate's prerelease_na_reason_fixed) use that text verbatim, so every repo gives the same answer.

evidence.description: The artifact a verifier can point at: a URL, a repo-relative path, or the output of the gate's command. Required for a pass on a gate the registry marks automatable.

then.description: A fail is always a finding; the reason is recorded so the next attempt knows what to fix.
